title: Repair render-history helper override
objective: Fix the run_orbit_workflow.sh render-history override path identified by Inspector while preserving default disabled render history.
instructions: Review Inspector finding and Builder render-history changes.

Make the helper default stable without injecting a mutually-exclusive flag that blocks --enable-render-history. Prefer omitting --disable-render-history from the helper because run_orbit_collection.py already defaults to disabled render history.
Update docs wording so they describe default disabled render history and the valid -- --enable-render-history helper override.
Add or run lightweight validation proving the helper override no longer conflicts, for example PYTHON=/bin/echo examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render -- --enable-render-history.
Run the relevant unittest module with spear-env.
definition_of_done: Helper default render still disables render history via Python default.
Helper can opt into --enable-render-history without argparse conflict.
